name: Great Zimbabwe
summary: The magnificent stone ruins of Great Zimbabwe, an ancient African city and one of Zimbabwe's most important cultural and historical landmarks.
description: Great Zimbabwe is an extraordinary archaeological site known for its massive granite stone walls, ancient enclosures, and impressive dry-stone architecture. The ruins provide a remarkable window into the history, culture, trade, and achievements of the medieval Kingdom of Zimbabwe.
travelTips: Wear comfortable walking shoes because the ruins involve uneven and sometimes steep terrain.
Allow several hours to explore the different sections of the monument.
Bring water, sunscreen, and a hat, particularly during warmer months.
Consider hiring a local guide to learn more about the history and significance of the ruins.
Carry small USD notes for local purchases and tips.
